verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no local engine, emulator, or offline sandbox for developing transformations. Snowflake Notebooks, dbt Projects on Snowflake, and Snowpark all run on billed Snowflake warehouse compute. The only free-tier reference is a community account of a credit-consuming free trial, which is a time-limited account rather than a dev-loop capability. Object cloning is an adjacent feature, and the cited evidence covers only privilege inheritance, not dev environments.
